svg.title: Orbiter 8 intro, zoom: the vape, clicked

g.text: Vape. Fourth today. I’m only counting.

svg.text: 23:41 · Curfew: violence high, security response limited · Block 7 · Unit 7-2216
You clicked the vape on the mattress: you sit and take a hit · click it again for another · Esc zooms out
No “Take a hit” button: you click the vape where
it lies. The camera eases in a little, you sit on
the mattress and take a hit, the vapor rises, and
Minerva notes the cost (pink: your health).
